Dylan-bot: Benchmarks CSV uploaded -> s3://redwood-marketing/benchmarks/2026-03-20/benchmarks.csv :white_check_mark:.

AJ: Tone decision: unified landing with anchor links for each mode wins SEO and navigation.

Maya: Agreed. Owners & deadlines: AJ, Sam, Bea - Thu EOD; Priya assemble slides Fri AM. Final ship midday Friday for Growth to stage the post. Ping Maya if blocked.

AJ: Will post Hosted draft v1 in shared doc in ~30m.
